detroit.songTitle: The Last Time I Saw Richard
detroit.line: The last time I saw Richard was Detroit in '68
detroit.lineNext: And he told me, "All romantics meet the same fate someday
stanza: The last time I saw Richard was Detroit in '68
And he told me, "All romantics meet the same fate someday
Cynical and drunk and boring someone in some dark café"
"You laugh," he said, "you think you're immune
Go look at your eyes, they're full of moon
You like roses and kisses and pretty men to tell you
All those pretty lies, pretty lies
When you gonna realize they're only pretty lies?
Only pretty lies, just pretty lies"
